method: Web search results reviewed on 24 Oct 2026; pages not opened unless evidence says page.

Several figures come from secondary summaries (exam-prep, aggregator, news sites); confidence is marked accordingly.
Coordinates were only recorded where a result stated them; others are null.

apply_routes.name: National Career Service (NCS) portal
apply_routes.owner: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
apply_routes.what: Free national job portal with job listings, career counselling, skill courses and online/offline job fairs.
apply_routes.eligibility: Any job seeker with a valid mobile number and an ID such as Aadhaar, voter card or PAN.
how: Enter name, date of birth, mobile, email and qualifications
Search jobs and job fairs in the Events section

apply_routes.name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) - Apprenticeship India portal
apply_routes.owner: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (DGT)
apply_routes.what: Paid apprenticeships with establishments; Government pays 25% of the stipend up to Rs 1,500 per month via DBT, employer pays at least 75%.
apply_routes.stipend: Minimum rates revised and notified 11 Sep 2025 (CPI-linked; figures not found in results). Older Rule 11 minimum: Rs 7,000/month for National or State Certificate (ITI) holders.
apply_routes.eligibility: Candidates (including ITI pass-outs) registered on the portal who meet the trade's minimum qualification.
how: Complete profile with Aadhaar and bank details
Search and apply to apprenticeship opportunities by trade and location
Accept offer and sign contract with the establishment
Receive stipend; Government share via DBT

apply_routes.name: National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS 2.0)
apply_routes.owner: Ministry of Education (Boards of Apprenticeship Training)
apply_routes.what: One-year apprenticeships for engineering/non-engineering graduates and diploma holders; Government reimburses 50% of stipend to employer.
apply_routes.stipend: From 1 Apr 2026 (secondary sources): graduates Rs 12,300/month; diploma Rs 10,900 (degree-institution category) or Rs 9,600 (vocational/diploma category).
apply_routes.eligibility: Graduates or diploma holders registered on the NATS 2.0 portal within the scheme's pass-out window.
how: Get enrolment number after document verification
Accept offer and sign apprenticeship contract

apply_routes.name: PM Internship Scheme
apply_routes.what: 12-month internships in top companies with monthly assistance and a one-time grant.
apply_routes.stipend: Rs 5,000/month plus one-time Rs 6,000 (original terms); some 2026 guides cite Rs 9,000/month - confirm on portal.
apply_routes.eligibility: Indian citizens aged 21-24, not in full-time job or full-time education, family income under Rs 8 lakh (sources conflict on newer limits).
how: Register on pminternship.mca.gov.in with Aadhaar-linked mobile
Choose up to the allowed number of internship preferences

apply_routes.name: UP Sewayojan / Rojgaar Sangam portal
apply_routes.owner: Employment Department (Sewayojan), Government of Uttar Pradesh
apply_routes.what: State registration and job matching; SMS/email alerts for matching vacancies and invitations to district Rozgar Melas.
apply_routes.eligibility: UP job seekers; registration free (one source says no age bar).
how: Register as Job Seeker on sewayojan.up.nic.in (Rojgaar Sangam: rojgaarsangam.up.gov.in)
Fill personal, education, skill and preference details
Watch for SMS/email on matching vacancies and Rozgar Mela invitations
Attend district Rozgar Mela (e.g. Gautam Buddh Nagar employment office)

apply_routes.name: UP district Rozgar Melas
apply_routes.owner: District Employment Offices, Government of Uttar Pradesh
apply_routes.what: Free district job fairs with private employers; e.g. Lucknow fair on 3 Aug 2026 had 2,800+ openings with salaries up to Rs 35,000.
apply_routes.eligibility: Registered job seekers matching employer requirements; no candidate fee.
how: Check district fair dates on the portal or employment office
Attend interviews on the fair day

apply_routes.name: Employment Bank, West Bengal
apply_routes.owner: Labour Department and IT Department, Government of West Bengal (Directorate of Employment)
apply_routes.what: State job seeker registry and job portal; linked to Yuvasree financial assistance.
apply_routes.stipend: Yuvasree: Rs 1,500/month to first one lakh enrolled job seekers (2013 terms; current status unverified).
apply_routes.eligibility: West Bengal resident job seekers; online registration must be validated at an Employment Exchange.
how: Visit any Employment Exchange to validate
Receive user ID and password by SMS
apply_routes.note: No search result confirmed a 'Karmasathi' employment portal; Employment Bank is the confirmed state portal.

apply_routes.name: Utkarsh Bangla / Karmadisha (PBSSD)
apply_routes.owner: Paschim Banga Society for Skill Development, Government of West Bengal
apply_routes.what: Free state skill training with placement support for wage and self-employment.
apply_routes.eligibility: West Bengal youth seeking short-term skill training (candidates apply through Karmadisha).
how: Choose a course and training centre

apply_routes.name: AICTE Internship Portal
apply_routes.owner: All India Council for Technical Education
apply_routes.what: Free national internship portal with paid and unpaid, remote and on-site internships; supports AICTE mandated credits (14-20 for B.Tech, 10-14 for 3-year diploma).
apply_routes.eligibility: Students of AICTE-approved institutions (degree and diploma) with current-year documents.
how: Register with academic details on internship.aicte-india.org
Create profile and upload current-year document

apply_routes.name: Skill India Digital Hub (SIDH)
apply_routes.owner: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship / NSDC
apply_routes.what: Digital platform for courses (incl. NSQF), apprenticeships, job opportunities linked to NCS, and verified credentials.
apply_routes.eligibility: Any learner or job seeker can register.
how: Enrol in courses or browse apprenticeships and jobs
